summary: Google DeepMind released version 2.2.0 of Concordia, an open-source agent-based social simulation library, with bug fixes, refactors, and new components like a HuggingFace language model wrapper and questionnaire support.

practices.reason: Dependency and API changes (Python version requirement, removed retry dependency, sampling parameter changes) would require adjustments for teams using this library.

New components like CombinedPerception and DayInTheLifeInitializer touch agent scaffolding but are minor additions to a research simulation toolkit rather than a stated technique with a measured gain.
